question:
An engineer must modify an overridden policy by changing the number of FCNS database entries to 1500 and then generate a message.
What configuration will accomplish this task?
options: event manager applet fcns_policy event fcns entries max-per-switch 1500 action 1.0 syslog priority warnings msg FCNS DB entries have reached the EEM limit action 2.0 policy-default
event manager applet fcns_policy override __fcns_entries_max_per_switch action 1.0 syslog priority errors 'CNS DB entries have reached the EEM limit' action 2.0 policy-default
event manager applet fcns_policy override __fcns_entries_max_per_switch event fcns entries max-per-switch 1500 action 1.0 syslog priority warnings msg FCNS DB entries have reached the EEM limit
event manager applet fcns_policy action 1.0 syslog priority warnings msg FCNS DB entries have reached the EEM limit action 2.0 event-default
theory: To change a pre-built system EEM policy (names beginning with '__'), you must use the 'override' keyword to replace it, and correctly re-specify both the event (the FCNS max-per-switch threshold of 1500) and the action (a syslog message) under that override applet. Simply redefining the action without overriding the underlying system event, or omitting the event statement entirely, would not actually change the FCNS entry threshold being monitored. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 16 — Automation and Scripting Tools)
